_doc: Per-tier budgets for the mountain showcase census (scripts/perfBudget.mjs, docs/DECISIONS.md). Counts are the scene-graph census (visible meshes, upper bound, no frustum culling), set at about 10 % over what was measured on 2026-10-30. Lower these when a PR makes the scene lighter; raising one needs a reason in docs/DECISIONS.md. Shadow numbers are 0 at Low (no shadow pass). loadMsFail is JS-only boot time on a slow CI box (measured 12-20 s) and only catches a blow-up. Heap is measured after a forced GC (lowest of 4 samples) and set about 30 % over (65 / 79 / 91 MB), so it only catches a real leak. The felt_* scenes (FL2) are the mountain showcase with a disaster 30 days (or 1 day for the flood) past its hit, so the felt layer's marks are drawn; their draw-call and triangle limits are the measured value plus 6 calls and 4 % (measured 2026-11-16: the felt layer adds 4 calls, 1 to 6k triangles and no shadow casters); shadow and heap limits are the mountain's. No existing limit was raised.
